mobvolume.screen.title: Mob Sounds
mobvolume.screen.open.tooltip: Set the volume of each mob separately.
mobvolume.screen.enabled.tooltip: Turn all volume changes from this mod on or off, e.g. to compare with the normal sounds. Your settings are kept.
mobvolume.screen.reset_all.title: Reset all mob volumes?

mobvolume.screen.expand: Separate volumes for each kind of sound

mobvolume.screen.category.tooltip: Volume of every mob in this category. Each mob's own volume is applied on top of it.
mobvolume.screen.preview: Play a sound to hear the volume
